title: Flux Krea
description: FLUX.1 Krea [dev] is a 12 billion parameter flow transformer that generates high-quality images from text with incredible aesthetics. It is suitable for personal and commercial use.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The prompt to generate an image from.

inputs.name: image_size
inputs.tooltip: The size of the generated image. 'custom' uses the width and height below.

inputs.name: num_inference_steps
inputs.tooltip: The number of inference steps to perform.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model will output the same image every time. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: guidance_scale
inputs.tooltip: The CFG (Classifier Free Guidance) scale is a measure of how close you want the model to stick to your prompt when looking for a related image to show you.

inputs.name: num_images
inputs.tooltip: The number of images to generate.

inputs.name: enable_safety_checker
inputs.tooltip: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked, and images flagged as unsafe are returned as black images.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: The format of the generated image.

inputs.name: acceleration
inputs.tooltip: The speed of the generation. The higher the speed, the faster the generation.

omitted.why: yes/no sync_mode returns the file inline and drops it from fal's request history - always left off
